:::{#thm-wcgs-age-slope}

#### Interpretation of the age coefficient in the WCGS interaction model

In the model of @eq-wcgs-model-1,
write $\odds(p, a) \eqdef \oddst(Y=1|P=p, A=a)$
and
$\ror(\Delta a = 1 | P = p) \eqdef \odds(p, a + 1) / \odds(p, a)$.
Then for every age $a$,
the age coefficient $\beta_A$ is the slope of the log-odds of CHD with respect to age
among participants with type B personality ($P = 0$):

$$
\beta_A
= \deriv{a}\eta(P=0, A = a)
= \eta(P = 0, A = a + 1)- \eta(P = 0, A = a)
$$

and $\expf{\beta_A}$ is the odds ratio per one-year difference in age
among participants with type B personality:

$$\expf{\beta_{A}} = \ror(\Delta a = 1 | P = 0)$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-logistic-coef-interp, worked in @sol-logistic-coef-interp.

:::
